newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK SAX HITS YEAR-HIGH ON BLUE CHIP GAINS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK SAX HITS YEAR-HIGH ON BLUE CHIP GAINS.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Slovak blue chips close mostly higher in flat
trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Monday, pushing the
SAX index slightly to a year-high.
* SAX up 0.24 points at 196.91.
* Slovnaft up five at 875 crowns, VSZ unchanged at 695, VUB
Bank up 75 at 1,800 crowns, Slovakofarma up 100 at 4,800
crowns.
*Overall volume 377,456 shares, turnover 228.65 million
crowns.
Slovak blue chips closed
mostly higher in flat trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange
on Monday, pushing the SAX index up 0.24 points to a year high
Drug producer Slovakofarma, which closed up 100 at 4,800
crowns, led the bourse higher, but brokers said only a few
issues were currently showing signs of life on the bourse.
"One can say several blue chips are performing very well,
and they manage to draw attention for the whole market,"
Radovan Dzugas of Creditanstalt said.
Steel maker VSZ closed unchanged at 695 crowns, with
dealers saying both it and Slovakofarma had the potential to
rise further.
Overall volume rose to 377,456 shares, from 276,291 shares
traded on Friday, while turnover eased to 228.65 million
crowns, from 352.38 million.
-- Peter Javurek, Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-521-8402
